Maya (docs): Quick async standup — yesterday: polished Python SDK Quickstart, added macOS M1 wheel note. Blocker: sampleapp CI failing on embed cache test; can't reproduce locally.

Alex: On it. Can you paste the failing test output? I'll review the codegen snippets after lunch.

Maya (docs): Here's the failing snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: Expected cache size 3 but got 0
tests/test_sampleapp.py::test_embed_cache
Command: pytest tests/test_sampleapp.py::test_embed_cache -q
```

Priya: I think the cache eviction TTL isn't set in sampleapp's config. Which runtime/quant is the sample using?

Maya (docs): Using gpt-open-7b q3 on dedicated-local. Config in repo: `sampleapp/config/cache.yaml` link: https://internal.redwood.dev/repos/sampleapp/blob/main/sampleapp/config/cache.yaml

Jordan: Pushed a tiny Dockerfile pin (libcuda=525) earlier — could affect local diff behavior. Try rebuilding with `make docker-rebuild`.

Sam: Quick reminder: sample quickstart for new users is:
```
pip install redwood-sdk
redwood quickstart --sdk python --project demo
```
Added that to the README in the quickstarts/ dir.

Maya (docs): Thanks @Alex @Priya — @Alex tagging you for code review when you have a minute. @Priya could you try a config patch and drop the diff here?

Alex: Will do. If CI still flakes, I'll add a retry in the test for the cache warmup (2s -> 50ms wait flake seen before).

docs-bot: CI build #249 failed on `tests/test_sampleapp.py::test_embed_cache` — see https://ci.internal.redwood.dev/builds/249 — :warning:

Priya: I opened a tiny PR https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/678 that sets `cache.ttl: 30s` and logs cache hits. Requesting review from @Alex.

Maya (docs): Great. No other blockers from docs side; planning to publish quickstart update by EOD. :thumbsup:

Alex: Reviewing now, will merge if green.

Sam: FYI I'll update the example in the quickstarts site to include the `--region` flag for new RPIs.

Maya (docs): Thanks team — closing my async check-in. Ping if anything blocks merge.
